# Sebald Beham ornament prints

A centaur frieze, candelabrum and mask panels, a palmette with dolphin heads, a double cup and three heraldic shields engraved by Sebald Beham, 1521–1545, from eight sheets in Washington and Hamburg; loose prints by one artist, grouped by sheet.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `beham-prints`, historical, 8 assets.

## Licence and attribution

Artwork: **LicenseRef-PDM** ([text](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/)). The Hamburg sheets carry the Public Domain Mark; the Washington sheets are CC0 and say so on the asset. See SOURCES.md.

Author: adrian729. Maintainer: https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets/issues. See [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md) and [SOURCES.md](SOURCES.md).
